WHICH SOURCE BECOMES WHICH PANELS. Two lists, because not every comic in this repository is a strip any more. `strips` is a multi-panel page that gets CUT: `source` is the file in art-source/cutscenes/, `name` is the base its panels take under public/assets/cutscenes/, and `panels` is how many the measurement is expected to find -- publish.py fails rather than publishing if the count moves, so a re-export that changes the layout is noticed here instead of on a phone. `pages` is a source that is ALREADY ONE FINISHED PANEL and is only encoded; it takes `name` as the whole output name and is never sliced. `measured` is written back by the run and is the record of the cut columns.
NOTHING HERE DECIDES WHERE A PANEL PLAYS. That is src/data/cutscenes.json, and it is the only file that knows.
